items.source: Process the AnnotationMetadata of the importing @Configuration class using the specified DeferredImportSelector.
items.translation: 使用指定的DeferredImportSelector处理导入的@Configuration类的AnnotationMetadata。

items.source: Return the AnnotationMetadata of the importing Configuration class.
items.translation: 返回导入的Configuration类的AnnotationMetadata。

items.source: This implementation resolves the type of annotation from generic metadata and validates that (a) the annotation is in fact present on the importing @Configuration class and (b) that the given annotation has an advice mode attribute of type AdviceMode.
items.translation: 此实现从通用元数据中解析注解类型，并验证 (a) 该注解确实存在于导入的 `@Configuration` 类上，以及 (b) 给定的注解具有类型为 advice mode attribute 的AdviceMode。

items.source: Select and return the names of which class(es) should be imported based on the AnnotationMetadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 AnnotationMetadata 选择并返回应导入的类名，该 AnnotationMetadata 属于 @Configuration 类。

items.source: Factory method to create a new AnnotationMetadata instance for the given class using standard reflection.
items.translation: 用于通过标准反射为给定类创建新的AnnotationMetadata实例的工厂方法。

items.source: Register bean definitions as necessary based on the given annotation metadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类的注解元数据，注册必要的 Bean 定义。

items.source: AnnotationMetadata implementation that uses standard reflection to introspect a given Class.
items.translation: 使用标准反射来内省给定Class的AnnotationMetadata实现。

items.source: Set the annotation metadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 设置导入的@Configuration类的注解元数据。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: Annotations and supporting classes for declarative cache management.
items.translation: 用于声明式缓存管理的注解和辅助类。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source: Core support package for type introspection.
items.translation: 用于类型内省的 Core 支持包。

items.source: Support classes for reading annotation and class-level metadata.
items.translation: 用于读取注解和类级别元数据的支持类。

items.source: Annotation-based retry and concurrency limit support.
items.translation: 基于注解的重试和并发限制支持。

items.source: Annotation support for asynchronous method execution.
items.translation: 支持异步方法执行的注解。

items.source: Spring's support for annotation-based transaction demarcation.
items.translation: Spring 对基于注解的事务划分的支持。

items.source:
Support for creating a registry of HTTP Service client proxies, and declaring
the proxies as beans.
items.translation: 支持创建 HTTP 服务客户端代理的注册表，并将这些代理声明为 Bean。

items.source:
Obtain the annotation metadata (as well as basic class metadata)
for this bean definition's bean class.
items.translation: 获取此 Bean 定义的 Bean 类的注解元数据（以及基本类元数据）。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition for the given annotation metadata,
allowing for ASM-based processing and avoidance of early loading of the bean class.
items.translation: 为给定的注解元数据创建一个新的 `AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition`，以支持基于 ASM 的处理并避免提前加载 Bean 类。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition for the given annotation metadata,
based on an annotated class and a factory method on that class.
items.translation: 为给定的注解元数据、该类的注解类以及该类上的工厂方法，创建一个新的 AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition。

items.source: Determine the order for the given configuration class metadata.
items.translation: 确定给定配置类元数据的顺序。

items.source:
Register, escalate, and configure the standard auto proxy creator (APC) against the
given registry.
items.translation: 注册、升级并针对给定注册表配置标准自动代理创建器（APC）。

items.source:
Read full annotation metadata for the underlying class,
including metadata for annotated methods.
items.translation: 读取底层类的完整注解元数据，包括已注解方法的元数据。

items.source: This method is called before any bean definition registrations are made.
items.translation: 此方法在注册任何 Bean 定义之前被调用。
